<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>ECI under pressure:</strong> The Election Commission has extended deadlines for Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in Delhi and Maharashtra and ordered a review of its ECINET software following intense political backlash and allegations of internal dissent.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxPN2pvTTlCWVFrT21UdUJ5MW80NzR2dDkzdzFFWVhrdkd4XzVCbVBKVmgyVHMySTRVeHB4R1ViZmVCNDUtVUdGRERSOVg3eU9fb1N6b1d4aWF0dm5lQUxpVDlLX2tnS0dfc3p2ZnBqNW5Ya3pscFdLV29nMUh4U0NPaGxDTTE1ZEFMRUpVLUwwR25leEJkbF9KOTNjZmlUWkZQSzltUDlCZmVlRjJPT0V5SzI0cnNaZ2pFR1VoOUJ2SlVQQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxOWl9qdEFEbVY3dkFpdGJ4d1RQMW8zQVBDVmZESGswWVhkMm53V3dWVEU0Vk9tQUx5ZzlRWDRoQjJ6a05sa3QyWUlzREotUkc2enFXRWZMa0NmcDZJNTF6NUVCc2M0el8xREVkVFdxUXNXTlkzOE5iVnd3TzZ2Q29NWGd5UFBmRFA5TEx2UTJXOC1sZ2pVUU9GWExaTmFOZzZOQUZER1pyQU8wemlFcm1UaDROQTNjbFo1MUkyaURYaFBBcHA3V3gwTHphNA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition mobilization:</strong> The INDIA bloc is scheduled to meet on September 30 to coordinate a national response against the Election Commission, with several leaders demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I26</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQWk9zOXNHR25HbWdGVTI1WHpWdHQzU0RMRkVrajFZY1B1Z3ZLWENDeDVuX0t1TDZSV21VaW51WnQ2aWlOaXhYOGlYV3JWY3dwWUJCZkNoRHh5VHBlSkIyLUZTZFN3LVJVQ3hranZLV1dEUnhzWkRKd2c4LWtpbVZZajg3TkVueGR2UEF0WHdxMGpSVnBJRm1vVnlYUGg4YmxNTFdUaTVBckZDT0FGX2NF?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Jan Suraaj expansion:</strong> Prashant Kishor’s Jan Suraaj party has announced plans to expand into Delhi, aiming to contest the 2027 municipal elections, the 2029 Lok Sabha polls, and the 2030 assembly elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legal challenges to ECI:</strong> The Supreme Court has referred a challenge against the 2023 law governing the appointment of Election Commissioners—which grants the executive a majority on the selection panel—to a five-judge Constitution Bench.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Internal dissent clarification:</strong> The Election Commission has formally denied reports of a policy-level rift, stating that recent letters sent by poll commissioners to the Cabinet Secretary were not related to policy matters.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
</ul>
